# Season Shelf 1.1.0

## Clearer Downloads

- Downloads now opens on **Ongoing**, showing active, queued, paused and other unfinished work. **Finished** shows completed downloads, newest first, replacing the duplicate Saved files screen.
- New network downloads can start while earlier files are being verified and saved. Disk finishing runs one file at a time, with a bounded backlog for slower drives.
- **Pause all**, **Resume all** and **Clear queue…** replace overlapping cancellation controls. Controls are disabled when there is nothing eligible to pause or resume.

## Predictable removal

- **Remove from history** and **Clear finished history…** keep completed files on disk.
- **Move file to Recycle Bin**, inside File details, is a separate confirmed disk-deletion action.
- Removing an unfinished download or clearing the queue deletes its temporary data after stopping its writer. Pausing still retains progress for resuming. Files already checking or transferring finish safely.
- Removing history or files preserves lifetime network usage, downloaded-byte totals and completed-file counts.
- Removing finished history makes the app forget those episodes, so **Select missing** may offer them again.

## Maintainability

Page renderers, reusable controls, display selectors, download actions, desktop handlers and styles now have dedicated modules. Regression coverage includes queue overlap, temporary cleanup, confirmation handling and preservation of lifetime totals.

## Install or update

**Windows:** use `Season-Shelf-Setup-1.1.0-x64.exe`, or install the update offered by the app. Update the existing installation to keep your settings and history.

**macOS:** use `Season-Shelf-1.1.0-mac-universal.dmg`, quit the app and replace it in Applications. Intel and Apple Silicon are supported.

Builds remain unsigned. Platform security prompts may appear. Existing downloaded media is preserved during an update.
